text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — planning the docs site deploy + SDK docs regen to line up with the release. Target window tonight 22:00 UTC. Need a short branch gate + version-bump confirmation. TL;DR steps I propose:

Maria Chen: 1) bump release/1.9.0 -> tag v1.9.0 2) push tag 3) kick SDK docs regen job 4) docs site deploy to prod (canary first)

Lee Patel: staging tests are green. minor lint warning on the console snippets but not blocking. OK for 22:00 if we fix the snippet before tag.

Samir Rao: changelog needs the feature list + one API note from #product. I can add a short summary now. Will submit small PR to release/1.9.0.

Maria Chen: nice — @Samir Rao please add the SDK changelog refs too (sdk/CHANGELOG.md) so the docs regen picks it up.

Evan Torres: I can run the SDK docs regen once the tag is pushed. Ping me after the tag. I’ll run the regen script and open a PR to docs/ site with the artifacts. My checklist:
- pull v1.9.0 tagged repo
- run `./scripts/generate-sdk-docs.sh`
- verify samples build
- open PR -> docs site

Lee Patel: for the tag use this command: `git tag -a v1.9.0 -m "release v1.9.0" && git push origin v1.9.0`

Maria Chen: suggested branch gating: require CI green on release/1.9.0 + changelog PR merged + docs snippet fix merged. If anything blocks after 21:30 UTC we roll to next slot.

Samir Rao: changelog PR created -> #PR-497. added product note and upgrade instructions for dedicated customers.

docsite-bot: docs-build queued for PR #PR-497. ETA ~8m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: reserved deploy window 22:00-22:30 UTC for eng-releases. Canary route enabled.

Evan Torres: regen done locally. samples passed. I’ll push artifacts to branch docs/sdk-v1.9.0 and open PR.

Maria Chen: awesome. When tag is pushed someone from eng-releases please paste the pushed SHA here and @Evan so he can start. Also include the release notes link.

Lee Patel: pushing tag now -> pushed v1.9.0 (sha: 3f9b2c1). @Evan Torres — go ahead.

Evan Torres: starting regen, will comment with PR when ready.

Samir Rao: changelog merged. ✅

docsite-bot: docs PR opened: https://git.example.com/docs/PR-812 — includes SDK artifacts and changelog bump.

Maria Chen: plan for deploy: canary to 5% for 10m, verify latency/errors, then full roll. If canary shows errors rollback to previous build.

Lee Patel: will watch metrics (console/dashboard route). I’ll mark monitoring alert at 21:50 to be ready.

deploy-bot: canary started at 22:00 UTC.

Evan Torres: PR merged, static assets uploaded.

docsite-bot: production deploy finished (canary -> full) at 22:12 UTC. No errors detected in first 15m.

Maria Chen: thanks everyone. Follow-ups: 1) post-mortem if anything odd, 2) ensure SDK package release note linked in docs homepage tomorrow.

Lee Patel: noted. Will keep an eye overnight. :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: closing thread — great work!
